# tosijs-pattern

> Matching that reads like what it means: a fluent, declarative alternative to regular
> expressions. Plain strings are literal text; nouns are characters (`digit`, `letter`,
> `charIn('a-z')`); verbs combine (`sequence`, `oneOf`, `oneOrMore`, `optional`, `capture`).
> No backtracking (possessive repetition, ordered choice), a step budget on every call, no
> RegExp inside, and patterns are validated JSON data.

- [README.md](README.md): the tour, with a regex-to-Pattern table.
- [docs-src/vocabulary.md](docs-src/vocabulary.md): every noun, verb and structural piece.
- [docs-src/from-regex.md](docs-src/from-regex.md): the planned translator, and why some regexes are refused.
- [DECISIONS.md](DECISIONS.md): semantics and why (read before assuming regex behaviour).
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): working in this repo.
